evidenceProvenance.reconstruction: The v1 manifest retained every selected thread and binding but only four preserved live threads. The post-apply native catalogs still matched the documented historical counts exactly on 2026-07-12: 152 default-visible and 90 archived live threads, plus the one preserved debug isolation thread. Those stable records complete the historical dry-run inventory. Current readback is embedded separately so later debug certification records are not mistaken for cleanup output.
